response.justification: Candidate is a versatile, senior full-stack engineer with strong distributed-systems and geospatial-adjacent experience, but lacks current, substantial C++ or Rust expertise, which is the core required technology for this role. His C++ work was brief (about 6 months, over a decade ago) and not listed among his primary skills, and he has no direct experience building routing tiles or navigation guidance systems.
strengths: Broad distributed systems experience (microservices, async I/O, low-latency apps at Dunnhumby)
Relevant geospatial/GIS domain exposure via GISCollective and Green Map projects
Strong track record of technical versatility and rapid skill acquisition across many stacks
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (~6 months, over 10 years ago), no Rust experience at all
No direct experience with routing/navigation tile pipelines or turn-by-turn guidance systems
Primary skill set (TypeScript, Node.js, D, JavaScript) diverges significantly from the C++/Rust systems focus required

key_factors.factor: Relevant geospatial and distributed systems background
